findings.claim: packages/input-host/src/BeamTool.ts:222 -- the reachable 3-D beam tool, constructed at initTools.ts:3254 and wired at :3529 -- dispatches `beam.create` with an EMPTY payload `{}` as fire-and-forget 'bus telemetry', then runs the real work through `this.commandManager.execute(command)`. That empty dispatch is not telemetry: canExecute passes (every field is optional), the handler mints an id, and the L0 Beam schema's `baseLine` DEFAULT commits a 4-metre beam at the world origin on level '' into the REAL beam store, once per 3-D beam the user draws. CommandEventBridge then correctly refuses to emit beam.created (no id, no geometry on the payload), so the ghost never reaches the legacy store, never renders, never persists and never exports -- it exists only in the model the plugin store owns, and it prints a console.error every time. Whether it also consumes an undo slot is UNVERIFIED (bootstrapWithEverything exposes rt.undoStack but undoCount was undefined in probe P-K).
